verdict.rationale: n8n documents itself as a workflow automation tool that can operationalize AI workflows and agents, and it provides webhook triggers and error workflows for unattended runs. Hands-on users report production use with scheduled and webhook-initiated tasks running at scale. However, first-party documentation of recurring schedule triggers is absent from the pack, and the schedule evidence comes only from community reports. missing for 10: first-party docs for schedule/cron triggers and background execution behavior, documented monitoring/alerting for unattended runs beyond the error-workflow mention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: n8n is a fair-code licensed workflow automation tool that combines AI features with business process automation.
Build and operationalize AI workflows and multi-step agents using your own data, models, and tools
With an error workflow, you can control how n8n responds to a workflow execution failure.
Currently my team use it for processing millions of workflows each year on a very small server
